data.description: Crawling through a tube and popping out at the far end is one of the first games small children invent, and the Crawling Tunnel is built around it. A ribbed tube in orange and baby blue runs between two shaped end panels, held up by grey posts at the corners. The tunnel sits just off the ground, so children crawl in on hands and knees, turn around inside or meet a friend coming the other way. It builds core strength and body awareness, and it makes a natural hideout in a game of chase. The product area is 8'10" x 4'6", with a safe play area of 13'10" x 9'6". Colours are Play Orange and Baby Blue. Galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts and composite laminates are under 3-year warranty. Ask us for a layout drawing.

props.pText: The tube and end panels are fixed to galvanised posts, which are grouted or installed self-standing. Rainwater can collect inside a tunnel, so check that it drains and wipe it out after heavy showers. Keep both openings clear within the 13'10" x 9'6" zone, and look inside for insects, nests or litter during maintenance.
